requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity regarding 'dial tone' resolved using glossary definition. Requirement interpreted as producing an audible signal to indicate line readiness. Structured as a single functional requirement.

fields.condition: when the telephony exchange system is ready to accept dialing input

structured_requirements.final_statement: The digital telephony exchange system shall produce an audible dial tone to indicate the line is ready.
structuring_notes: Ambiguity resolved: 'Generate a dial tone' interpreted as producing an audible signal based on glossary definition ('Tone signaling line readiness'). Generic action interpretation excluded.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific tone frequency, duration, or volume — only the production of an audible signal was required by the resolved interpretation.
